sources.title: Bounds on Slow Roll and the de Sitter Swampland

evidence.text: Does consistent quantum gravity forbid positive-energy de Sitter vacua or sustained potential slow roll? The paper investigates this question through restricted tree-level string compactifications while recognizing that their evidential scope is narrower than a universal quantum-gravity principle.

sources.title: The quantum swampland

evidence.text: Can balancing classical contributions against quantum loops produce metastable de Sitter space? A correction can be perturbatively small for moduli stability yet dominate the residual cosmological constant after cancellations.

sources.title: Bounds on Slow Roll at the Boundary of the Landscape

evidence.text: Do potential slow-roll obstructions exclude quantum de Sitter vacua, or characterize the tree-level boundary of the string landscape? A separate issue is whether families of solutions can approach arbitrarily weak coupling while retaining de Sitter.

sources.title: Quintessence Axion Revisited in Light of Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: Can the vacuum structure associated with a fixed electroweak theta angle coexist with conjectural restrictions on stable de Sitter and nonsupersymmetric AdS vacua? The paper uses the refined de Sitter formulation and explicitly qualifies the treatment of negative-energy minima.

sources.title: Open problems on classical de Sitter solutions

evidence.text: Does difficulty finding de Sitter solutions in an asymptotic large-field limit exclude a finite but controlled anisotropic regime?

sources.title: The Swampland: Introduction and Review

evidence.text: Can a positive-energy string vacuum survive the consistency and control tests required of a quantum-gravity solution? Positive maxima and metastable minima test different versions of the de Sitter conjectures.

sources.title: QCD, Flavor, and the de Sitter Swampland

evidence.text: Must a putative quantum-gravity completion satisfy the de Sitter conjecture in a metastable QCD sector, even when the Universe occupies the QCD ground state? The source assumes that it must.

sources.title: Obstacles to Constructing de Sitter Space in String Theory

evidence.text: Can metastable de Sitter space exist in string theory, and can a controlled calculation establish its existence? The paper separates existence from the reliability of stationary-point searches and from control over the entire cosmological history.

sources.title: Bounds on Slow Roll and the de Sitter Swampland

evidence.text: Replace explicit critical-point field values by potential energies, solve the resulting linear constraints, and optimize the normalized smallest Hessian eigenvalue subject to signs. The procedure yields sufficient instability bounds without finding individual vacua, provided the scaling truncation and scalar normalization are valid.

sources.title: The quantum swampland

evidence.text: Select an instantaneous Minkowski state when each mode reaches k/a=Λ, then evolve it below the cutoff. This continuous entry rule replaces the unlimited ultraviolet tracing used for Bunch–Davies selection.

sources.title: Bounds on Slow Roll at the Boundary of the Landscape

evidence.text: Scan λ and four scalar variables in the stated bounded box, retain positive selected pieces with residuals below 0.05, and inspect the smallest logarithmic-Hessian eigenvalue. Tightening the residual is a convergence diagnostic rather than proof of exhaustive critical-point coverage.

sources.title: Quintessence Axion Revisited in Light of Swampland Conjectures

evidence.text: The source evolves inverse gauge couplings piecewise across specified heavy thresholds. Only the caption and prose were available; the plotted curves, axis ticks, and numerical integration were not independently inspected or reproduced.

sources.title: Open problems on classical de Sitter solutions

evidence.text: Divide quantized periods by actual cycle volumes before replacing them by average-length powers. Compare the resulting densities with curvature and source terms while checking all physical lengths and weak coupling.

sources.title: The Swampland: Introduction and Review

evidence.text: Evaluate proposed constraints against controlled constructions and independently motivated infrared arguments, recording assumptions and construction quality. The review distinguishes complete worldsheet constructions from more assumption-dependent string-inspired models and treats their agreement as graded evidence.

sources.title: de Sitter decay through goldstino evaporation

evidence.text: Which conjectural quantum-gravity restrictions motivate an instability of apparently metastable de Sitter EFT vacua? The paper distinguishes scalar-potential restrictions from conjectures that can allow de Sitter provided its lifetime is short.

sources.title: The Anthropic landscape of string theory

evidence.text: Can string theory supply sufficiently diverse vacua for anthropic selection, can cosmology populate suitable environments, and can metastable de Sitter phases receive a precise quantum definition?

sources.title: On the de Sitter swampland criterion

evidence.text: Do unstable ten-dimensional de Sitter solutions violate a conjecture about four-dimensional quantum-gravity effective theories? The paper separates three possibilities: invalid backgrounds, a mismatch between consistent and low-energy truncations, and a weaker criterion concerning stable vacua.

sources.title: dS Vacua and the Swampland

evidence.text: Would an observed departure of dark energy from w = -1 distinguish a landscape containing de Sitter vacua from a conjecture forbidding those vacua?

sources.title: The Top $10^{500}$ Reasons Not to Believe in the Landscape

evidence.text: Do string constructions and Coleman–De Luccia (CDL) transitions justify a connected landscape of metastable vacua and global eternal inflation (EI), and can anthropic landscape reasoning reproduce observed low-energy physics?

sources.title: No asymptotic acceleration without higher-dimensional de Sitter vacua

evidence.text: Can rolling scalars produce accelerated expansion at infinite field-space distance without requiring a higher-dimensional metastable de Sitter vacuum?
